issues.description: The proposal includes fabricated company metrics and client references not found in the Client Matrix, specifically '40% growth', '600 contracted drivers', '40 dispatchers', and a past engagement with 'Cascade Freight'. Presenting hallucinated facts would severely damage the firm's credibility.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove all hallucinated metrics and peer references. Restrict the background information strictly to the facts provided in the Client Matrix.

issues.description: The proposal invents specific technologies for the client's stack ('Rails 5', 'Sales Cloud', 'NetSuite', 'React Native') that are not mentioned in the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the hallucinated technology names with the exact terms used in the matrix (e.g., 'custom dispatch tool', 'Salesforce', 'driver mobile app').

issues.description: The proposal fabricates a past engagement pricing benchmark ('$150,000 to $250,000' for a peer freight brokerage) which is not supported by the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the fabricated pricing benchmark. Keep the focus on the CFO's requirement for a fixed-fee, milestone-based structure, noting that final pricing will be determined once the budget and scope contradictions are resolved.

issues.description: Committing to a definitive '6-month Phase 1 engagement' may inadvertently conflict with the unresolved Q3 vs Q4 pilot timeline contradiction correctly identified in the Open Questions section.
issues.suggested_fix: Soften the language around the 6-month timeline. Indicate that the exact duration and phase timing will be finalized once the pilot timeline and core technical approach are agreed upon by the leadership team.

risks: The inclusion of hallucinated data (metrics, tech stack, past clients, pricing) poses a massive risk to the firm's reputation if this draft were to reach the client.

There is deep internal misalignment within the client's leadership team regarding the budget cap, technical approach, and timeline. These must be resolved before a binding Statement of Work can be drafted.
